transcript.text:
Updated:

```yaml
name: Enrich IP And Alert
steps:
  - id: lookup
    type: connector
    connector: virustotal
    operation: lookup_ip
    args: {ip: '{{vars.ip}}'}
  - id: alert
    type: connector
    when: '{{ lookup.result.reputation < 0 }}'
    connector: cyops_utilities
    operation: create_alert
    args: {name: 'Bad IP {{vars.ip}}'}
```
